casesPassingDecidingGate: 10/10 at N=20 (200 pairs); negative controls: 3 of 4 fail on both cases, straight-alpha fails on the alpha case
caveats: Oracle is SwiftUI's ImageRenderer at scale 2.5 (decision G50, provisional), not the on-screen NSHostingView path; on-screen confirmation is pending the Mac being free.

Fitted filters per level (G52): none nearest; low and default bilinear; medium bilinear after 2x2 box halvings; high the same halvings with a Mitchell-Netravali cubic (B 0.72, C 0.12), an extra beyond the five named filters.

ratios-checker PASSES only after decision G73: the 3x medium 1 px checker cell has a per-channel mean residual of 0.88 (max 1 level) that the filter does not model exactly; the tolerance (mean 0.9, from the calibration including 1 px checker pages) absorbs it. The residual is 0.878, which passes only because it rounds to 0.9. This is a named limit, not a fit.
Odd-sized sources reduced by more than 2:1 are not reproduced (G53). `.high` at 1:1 smooths on the Mac, so 1:1 is exact only for none, low, medium and default.
A named Mac-side corner artifact (macCornerSpill, G55) is allowed one pixel above the rect with antialiased fractional origins; it is counted and reported.
The transient live-resize path (isLiveResizing) is unit-tested only; there is no settled-capture gate for it. aspectRatio is an Image modifier only.
